sliders.title: What matters to you, and what if the weather changes?
sliders.intro: Move a slider to re-rank the rotations. Scores are model-based counterfactuals, not promises.
sliders.priorities.title: What matters most
sliders.priorities.hint: From 0 (does not matter) to 5 (matters most). The ranking updates at once; nothing is simulated again.
sliders.scenario.title: What if the weather changes?
sliders.scenario.hint: Every real season is replayed again with the weather changed by this much.
sliders.rain.label: Rainfall change
sliders.temp.label: Warming
sliders.preset.title: Quick scenarios
sliders.preset.drought_year.detail: 30 % less rain and 1 °C warmer, all year.
sliders.spring.note: This scenario changes spring only. Moving a slider applies a change to the whole year.
sliders.projection.note: A climate scenario for 2050 is active. Moving a slider replaces it.
sliders.status.waiting: Waiting for you to stop moving the slider…
sliders.status.replaying: Replaying every season with the changed weather. The cards below still show the previous results.
sliders.status.replayed: Replay finished. The cards now show {scenario}.
sliders.robust.title: Which rotation holds up best?
sliders.robust.body: How far each score falls in a drought year, hot spring or wet spring. Smaller is better.
sliders.robust.computing: Testing each rotation against a drought year, a hot spring and a wet spring…
sliders.robust.error: The robustness check could not run: {message}
sliders.robust.best: Most robust: {name}. Its score falls by at most {drop}, in a {scenario}.
sliders.robust.bestNoDrop: Most robust: {name}. Its score does not fall in any of the scenarios tested.
sliders.robust.list: Largest score fall for each rotation
sliders.robust.rowNoDrop: {name}: does not fall in any scenario tested
